name: IBY_TEMP_EXT_PAYEES
description: IBY_TEMP_EXT_PAYEES stores payment processing attributes for external payees.

columns.name: TEMP_EXT_PAYEE_ID
columns.description: Primary identifier. Populated by Oracle.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Interface record status. Valid values: NEW, PROCESSED, REJECTED.

columns.name: PAYMENT_FUNCTION
columns.description: Interface record type. Use: PA.

columns.name: PARTY_ID
columns.description: Party identifier. Use the Manage Suppliers task to identify valid values. Use either PARTY_ID or VENDOR_CODE, but not both. Foreign key to party at HZ_PARTIES_ALL.PARTY_ID.

columns.name: ORG_TYPE
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.  Valid values:  Business Group, Legal Entity, Business Unit.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Identifies the business unit. Use the Manage Business Units task to identify valid values.

columns.name: BANK_CHARGE_BEARER
columns.description: Party that is responsible for paying regular or express bank charges, such as payee or payer. Valid values: BEN, OUR, SHA, PAYEE_PAYS_EXPRESS. BEN means payee. OUR means payer.  SHA means shared. PAYEE_PAYS_EXPRESS means express charges.

columns.name: PARTY_SITE_ID
columns.description: Party site use identifier. Use the Manage Suppliers task to identify valid values.

columns.name: SUPPLIER_SITE_ID
columns.description: Supplier site identifier. Use the Manage Suppliers task to identify valid values.

columns.name: DEFAULT_PAYMENT_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Default payment method. Use the Management Payment Methods task, Payment Method Codes option, to identify valid values.

columns.name: ECE_TP_LOCATION_CODE
columns.description: Trading partner location code for the e-Commerce Gateway. Free text field. Not validated.

columns.name: BANK_INSTRUCTION1_CODE
columns.description: Bank instruction code. Use the Manage Payment Codes task, Bank Instruction option to identify valid values.

columns.name: BANK_INSTRUCTION2_CODE
columns.description: Bank instruction code. Use the Manage Payment Codes task, Bank Instruction option to identify valid values.

columns.name: BANK_INSTRUCTION_DETAILS
columns.description: Additional bank instruction details. Free text field. Not validated.

columns.name: PAYMENT_REASON_CODE
columns.description: Payment reason code provided by government or central bank. Use the Manage Payment Codes task, Payment Reason option, to identify valid values.

columns.name: PAYMENT_REASON_COMMENTS
columns.description: Reason for payment. Free text field. Not validated.

columns.name: PAYMENT_TEXT_MESSAGE1
columns.description: Payment message. Free text field. Not validated.

columns.name: PAYMENT_TEXT_MESSAGE2
columns.description: Payment message. Free text field. Not validated.

columns.name: PAYMENT_TEXT_MESSAGE3
columns.description: Payment message. Free text field. Not validated.

columns.name: DELIVERY_CHANNEL_CODE
columns.description: Indicates how to execute payment. Use the Manage Payment Codes task, Delivery Channel option, to identify valid values.

columns.name: PAYMENT_FORMAT_CODE
columns.description: Payment format code. Use the Manage Formats task, Disbursement Payment File Formats option, to identify valid values.

columns.name: EXCLUSIVE_PAYMENT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether similar documents payable are prevented from being grouped for payment. Valid values: Y, N.

columns.name: SETTLEMENT_PRIORITY
columns.description: Priority for executing payment. Valid values: NORMAL, EXPRESS. Valid values defined by lookup IBY_SETTLEMENT_PRIORITY.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Date payee record becomes active. Date format: YYYY/MM/DD. Must be earlier than END_DATE.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Date payee record becomes inactive. Date format: YYYY/MM/DD. Must be later than START_DATE.

columns.name: FEEDER_IMPORT_BATCH_ID
columns.description: Unique number to identify the batch. Free text field. Not validated.

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM
columns.description: Original system for the external payee. Not used for Oracle Cloud implementations. Free text field. Not validated.

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE
columns.description: Original system reference for the external payee. Not used for Oracle Cloud implementations. Free text field. Not validated.

columns.name: LOCAL_INSTRUMENT_CODE
columns.description: Payment method for a specific locale. Use the Management Payment Codes task, Local Instrument option, to identify valid values.

columns.name: REMIT_ADVICE_DELIVERY_METHOD
columns.description: Communication method for delivering remittance advice. Valid values: EMAIL, FAX, PRINTED.

columns.name: REMIT_ADVICE_EMAIL
columns.description: E-mail address of the payee for receiving remittance advice. Should be in standard email format with @.  Not validated.

columns.name: REMIT_ADVICE_FAX
columns.description: Fax number of the payee for receiving remittance advice. Free text field. Not validated.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. Incremented every time the row is updated.  Compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: VENDOR_CODE
columns.description: Vendor code. Use the Manage Suppliers task to identify valid values. Use either PARTY_ID or VENDOR_CODE, but not both.

columns.name: VENDOR_SITE_CODE
columns.description: Vendor Site Code. Use the Manage Suppliers task to identify valid values.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: request ID of the loader job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: BUSINESS_UNIT
columns.description: Indicates the business unit of the Payee
